top_signals.title: China Burns Less Oil and Coal as the Iran War Reshapes Its Energy Mix
top_signals.summary: The war in Iran is causing an enduring upset in global oil and gas markets with long-ranging consequences for the economy, the energy sector, and the climate. For many countries, this has resulted in skyrocketing energy prices and a rapid shift toward renewable energies in order to fill the import gap. For China, the global leader in clean energy supply chains by a massive margin, this has resulted in a windfall – and a drop in greenhouse gas emissions.  China has led global clean energy development for years now, spending more than…

top_signals.title: Sify Infinit Said to Revive $396 Million India IPO Plan
top_signals.summary: Sify Infinit Spaces Ltd. is once again gauging investor appetite for its planned 37 billion-rupee ($396 million) initial public offering in India, according to people familiar with the matter, joining a growing list of companies returning to the market as sentiment improves.
